description.value: Oasis Inn is a family-run motel on Gordon Drive in central Kelowna with over 25 years of continuous operation at the same location. All rooms include A/C, fridge, microwave, and wireless internet, and the property offers on-site coin-op laundry. Its central Kelowna position puts cycling tourists close to the city's beaches, wineries, and Okanagan trail networks.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM record details: address (1884 Gordon Drive, Kelowna, BC V1Y 3H7), phone (250-763-3657), and name match. The website explicitly mentions on-site coin-op laundry and wireless internet in all rooms, corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. There is no mention anywhere of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, drying areas, breakfast, e-bike charging, tools, pump, or bike wash, so all cycling-specific required criteria and most optional amenities are null.
concerns: Toll-free number 1-888-493-8893 appears on website but is absent from OSM tags.
Email field appears blank in scraped website content despite OSM listing info@oasiskelowna.ca — may be a rendering artifact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate motel with confirmed amenities (laundry, Wi-Fi), but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed or denied from available evidence; direct outreach needed before listing.

Laundry.detail: On-site coin-op laundry mentioned on website front page
